Generated Pokédex codes · 784 species · 1082 cards

Pokédex QR codes for every Pokémon you can scan

A working QR code for every Pokémon and form the Gen VII QR Scanner accepts. Pick a Pokémon, flip ♂/♀ and Shiny, then tap the code to show it big for your 3DS camera.

How these codes work
  • Scanning registers the Pokémon as seen in the Pokédex; it doesn’t give you the Pokémon. Each gender and shiny version registers separately, so scan each one you want.
  • The scanner holds 10 scans and recharges one every 2 hours, and won’t accept the same code twice until your next Island Scan.
  • Pokémon #785–807 and Pikachu’s Cap forms can’t be added with any QR code: see the list at the bottom.
  • The rules come from reverse-engineering the Ultra Moon v1.2 QR Scanner and running its own code. Cards marked “Tested on 3DS” were also tried on a real Ultra Moon; Sun, Moon and Ultra Sun are untested.

QR codes are drawn in your browser from payloads signed and verified when the page is built.

Only the species, form, gender, shiny flag, registration lanes and signature change.

  • QR drawing: qrcode-generator 2.0.4 by Kazuhiko Arase, MIT license.
  • Protocol background: published Gen VII QR reverse-engineering discussion.
